name: TRADE! 🤝 Champion Defenders ⚔️ TDS
desc:
⚔️ Welcome to Champion Defenders! Protect your base, build defenses, lead your units, and summon for better stats to become the ultimate Champion Defender! Are you up to the task? ⚔️

💰 Hunt! Take your team on the hunt and earn free rewards!
💫 Crafting! Merge your units together for a guaranteed better rarity!
✨ Battlepass Season 1: Anime Action! Unlock 50 free rewards or upgrade to premium for 2x rewards!
🤝 Trading! Achieve level 10 to unlock trading with other players!
🗺️ Campaign! Complete the various chapters to unlock new maps, do you think you have what it takes to beat the campaign? 🤺

📝 Upcoming Updates:
- Swords, upgrade and swap your sword skins!
- Unit Abilities, units will be able to do more damage with unique effects

⭐ Premium users receive 50% more gems from quests!
💎 Join our group, favorite, and like the game for free daily gems!
❓ Have a question or bug? Report it in our group or community!
